title: Import and Export Data
readerIntent: Understand how governed data enters and leaves Nodics.
priorKnowledge: Understand schemas, validation, access policy, and tenant context.
owner: Nodics import and export capability families
summary: Import converts approved sources into schema or search operations through one auditable lifecycle; export applies access policy and renders governed outbound contracts, with current maturity stated separately.

sections.heading: Business outcomes
items: Load core, sample, partner, migration, catalog, and operational data consistently.
Deliver governed feeds, extracts, reports, and Data-as-a-Service contracts.
Reuse validation, authorization, tenant isolation, models, search, events, diagnostics, and run history.
Add formats and external transports through adapters and configuration.

sections.heading: Maturity
paragraphs: The shared import lifecycle and CSV, Excel, JSON, and trusted active-module JavaScript formats are implemented. Remote source transports require project/provider configuration and live qualification. Export has a guarded shared boundary and fail-closed base service; production writers and delivery providers must be completed and qualified before use.
